scope: Only the acquisition-to-use continuation and owned F01 additions; other sessions remain untouched

shared_fragments.text: **取得记录与实际使用 / Acquired readings and native use，2026-10-08。** [理论第12节](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md#acquired-support-use)接通已获记录、逐位置核对与原生取得；无关变化可以继续，指定重试历史有精确预算条件。新增28项 Lean 定理／70项总审计通过。[整合与反审](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SUPPORT-USE-INTEGRATION.md)。/ The local acquisition-to-use bridge is complete under coherent reads, full revision maintenance and atomic validate/use. Finite budgets can be exhausted by repeated invalidation. Concrete realization remains separate; established optimistic validation is credited and no frontier novelty is claimed.

**取得与使用接通 / Acquired information to use，2026-10-08。** [当前第12节](unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md#acquired-support-use)用28项新 Lean 定理连接取得记录、版本核对与同一原生取得过程，并证明指定重试历史的精确代价。/ Unrelated changes may proceed; correct stale-record rejection can exhaust every finite budget. The conditional execution bridge is complete, while sensing and atomicity require implementation evidence.

**读取到执行续研完成 / Acquisition-to-use completed，2026-10-08。** [过程对应、代价、来源及作者反审](ACQUIRED-SUPPORT-USE-INTEGRATION.md)新增28项定理／70项闭包审计（38空）；已有交接、保护区间和证据成本结果直接复用。/ Maintained records validate native use under explicit coherent-read and atomic-use laws; a one-way trace projection retains read costs separately. Selective interference, conservative rejection and exact retry/exhaustion witnesses are checked. This closes the preceding local bridge without deriving physical sensing or novelty.

**Acquired support use, 8 October 2026.** [Record/use refinement](AcquiredSupportUse.lean) and [interference/cost cases](AcquiredSupportUseCases.lean) add 28 theorems (8 empty, 20 standard propext and/or Quot.sound; no choice). [Checker](check_acquired_support_use.py): 70 closure audits, 38 empty, including 42 inherited audits. [Integration and counterreview](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SUPPORT-USE-INTEGRATION.md) specify coherent sampling, full per-slot revision maintenance, atomic validated use, trace projection and the exact prescribed retry cost; no hardware or fairness proof.

**取得与执行的对应 / Acquired evidence and native use，2026-10-08。** F01成对追加[同一过程的读取／执行整合](ACQUIRED-SUPPORT-USE-INTEGRATION.md)：28项新定理／70项闭包审计、逐位置核对、精确重试代价及预算耗尽见证。/ Only owned F01 additions, read/authored fingerprints and the canonical row change. Prior and concurrent entry content and unrelated pending reviews are preserved. [Edits](ACQUIRED-SUPPORT-USE-INDEX-EDITS.json); [scoped checks](ACQUIRED-SUPPORT-USE-CHECKS.json). No whole-table or independent certification.

entry_before.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entry_before.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。 新的有限逐前缀继续谓词接入同一核心：每个请求步骤可继续，全部完成终点满足目标；有相反回应与成功后须调整的机制见证。 第二轮从原生占用规律推出局部历史允许的固定上下文精确判据；单相关支承位摘要保留所选工作负载的执行与整体事件步数预算。 第三轮证明：当前接入相同，允许改接范围内占用一致，当且仅当全部允许有限历史可行性一致。
entry_before.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound. A finite prefix-sensitive obligation extends the same core: every requested step can continue and all completed endpoints meet the target, with mechanisms for opposite responses and adjustment after success. A continuation derives the exact frozen-context criterion from native occupancy laws; a relevant-slot summary preserves selected execution and merged-state event-count budgets. A third round proves that, at equal current routes, agreement on permitted-slot occupancy is equivalent to agreement on every allowed finite-word feasibility judgment.
entry_before.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；第一轮提出的上下文与摘要目标已由本次有范围结果接续。 新11项定理继承39项审计；50项中44空、6仅标准依赖。终点正确可遗漏中断；实际调度、物理时间与目标伦理根据另列。 新37项定理／220项闭包审计（124空）；新证明无经典选择。初始完整相容性、局部历史与固定占用条件明示；总量摘要失败，单支承摘要不能认证遗漏位置的相容性。整体预算不等于保持其他占用的准备，步数不等于真实时间。Iris/Leaf已有先例，仍属完成的整合而非新颖性证明。 新24项定理／42项总审计（30空）；原生三步历史产生旧工作负载等价、扩展范围可区分的配置。旧摘要加目的地不足以总能更新摘要。允许范围、原子性和身份给定；不禁止无损编码，未解决新读数取得或确立前沿新颖性。已完成交错研究直接复用。
entry_before.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; the first-round context/abstraction target is continued by the scoped results below. Eleven new theorems plus 39 inherited audits; 44 of 50 reports empty, six standard only. Correct endpoints can omit interruption; scheduling, physical time and ethical target warrant remain separate. Continuation: 37 new theorems / 220 closure audits (124 empty), no new choice dependency. Full initial compatibility, a valid local history and a frozen frame are explicit. Counts lose readiness; the selected summary loses hidden-slot compatibility. Merged-state budgets do not imply preparation preserving held occupancy, and steps are not physical time. Iris/Leaf precedents remain credited; the scoped integration is complete, without a novelty claim. Reconfiguration: 24 new theorems / 42 total audits (30 empty). A native three-event history witnesses old-workload equivalence and separation under wider access; old active-view plus destination cannot always determine the new view. Permission scope, identities and atomicity remain supplied. Lossless encodings remain possible; observation acquisition and novelty are not established. Completed interleaving work is reused.
